title: Production review finding
description: One record per reviewer finding on real work. This is the online shadow evaluation: outcome data accumulates from reviews you were doing anyway, instead of from a hand-labeled corpus. It is NOT ground truth -- see `lead_disposition` -- and the metrics it feeds are keep-or-drop signals, not publishable effects.

review_id.description: the review this finding came from; the unit of resampling, exactly as items are in LRHE

epoch_commit.description: immutable repository epoch the reviewer saw

source_evidence.description: raw evidence field; path:line anchors are extracted from it

lead_disposition.description: the integrator's call. NOT independent: the integrator is itself one of the families being compared, which is the single-family-judge problem LRHE-PROTOCOL.md section 5.2 calls disqualifying. Sample it against a cross-family panel and track the kappa -- shadow_ledger.py audit.

verification_result.description: outcome of actually running verification_procedure. Outranks lead_disposition wherever both exist, for the same reason execution outranks agreement in the verdict lattice.

refuted_by.description: family that falsified it in the cold-refuter lane

resulting_change.description: captured automatically from repository history; see shadow_ledger.py outcomes

anchor_valid_at_epoch.description: did the anchored path exist at epoch_commit? A finding anchored nowhere is unactionable regardless of how it was dispositioned.

needs_human.description: true only for the three cases worth your attention: unresolved P0/P1, an irreversible tradeoff with no empirical answer, or a proposed invariant waiver
